To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

multimodal imaging, integrating morphological and DCE-MRI features, had the best diagnostic accuracy in the evaluation of preoperative treatment response in locally advanced rectum cancer, and that PET/CT is also useful for the evaluation of treatment response.
multimodal imaging, integrating morphological and function MRI features, has the best accuracy both for sensitivity and specificity in the assessment of therapy response in LARCs.
MRI, DCE MRI and DWI can be useful in the evaluation of neoadjuvant treatment response in LARC.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of multimodal imaging in the assessment of the treatment response of rectal cancer, with a special focus on the role of MRI and DCE-MRI.
the use of MRI, DCM-MRI and DWI in the evaluation of neoadjuvant treatment response in LARC.
the use of MRI in diagnosis, staging, treatment response assessment, and follow-up in patients with rectal cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
multimodal imaging, integrating morphological and function MRI features, is the best imaging approach for therapy response assessment in rectal cancer.
multimodal imaging, integrating morphological and function MRI features, is the modality with the best diagnostic accuracy for therapy response assessment in locally rectal cancer.
MRI is the imaging modality of choice in rectal cancer staging and DCE-MRI is the best functional modality to evaluate therapy response in LARCs.

multimodal MRI and DCE-MRI have high accuracy in predicting the neoadjuvant treatment response in LARC.
the use of multimodal imaging, integrating morphological and dynamic contrast enhanced features, may help in the assessment and in the planning of the surgical treatment of LARC.
multimodal imaging and functional MRI may be a valid tool for pre-surgery therapy response assessment in patients with LARC.

the multimodal imaging integrating functional MRI features has a better accuracy to evaluate therapy response in LARG.
